notes: 25 candidates: 8 program-list, 0 single-record, 17 not-a-list. Institutions by host all kept. Caveats for the integrator: (1) the two Clemson TigerPrints dissertation indexes (all_dissertations, arv_dissertations) are university-wide across every department and the captures are truncated, so they are only useful after filtering to management/industrial engineering; the department sub-collections named on the tigerprints.clemson.edu/dissertations/ landing page (Industrial Engineering, Industrial Management, Management, Management and Information Systems) would be better sources. (2) The Weatherhead Designing Sustainable Systems lists (2015, 2016) are the executive PhD in Management track (practitioner cohort), not the full-time PhD; 2016 gives current positions, which are not first jobs. (3) The Columbia GSB dissertation pages mix all five doctoral divisions (Accounting, DRO, Finance and Economics, Management, Marketing); the 2016 capture is page 1 of 3 and the 2015 capture shows only three entries. (4) The CORC theses page covers IEOR optimization PhDs 2003-2007 only.
